description: Starts a free WozApi trial without an account and returns a trial_code. The trial covers WOZ value lookups for 5 unique Dutch addresses, or 10 when the user's own e-mail address is given. Pass the trial_code to lookup_woz_value and start_address_list. Call it once per conversation, and not when the user is signed in to WozApi or the connection already has a WozApi API key.

email.description: Optional. The user's own e-mail address, only if the user typed it. Never invent one.

name: start_trial
title: Gratis proef starten
